review_candidates.title: Solar Electrical Power Engineer - Experienced
review_candidates.description: Company Description At UniPower, we provide advanced power quality and engineering solutions supported by over 26 years of experience in the field. We serve organizations across multiple sectors by protecting critical operations, improving energy efficiency, and ensuring reliable, uninterrupted performance. Our comprehensive approach covers consultancy, design, implementation, and ongoing support, giving clients end-to-end engineering services. UniPower focuses on reducing operational risk, enabling business continuity, and delivering long-term value through engineering excellence and dependable power solutions. Team members join a stable, growth-oriented environment committed to technical rigor and practical innovation. Role Description The Solar Engineer – Electrical Power Machine Graduated role is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm 2nd 6 October. The role involves designing and reviewing solar PV and electrical power systems, preparing technical drawings and documentation, and supporting detailed load calculations and system sizing. The engineer will participate in site assessments, assist in installation supervision, and collaborate with project teams to ensure compliance with codes, standards, and client requirements. Day-to-day tasks include performance analysis, troubleshooting system issues, coordinating with suppliers and contractors, and supporting the integration of solar solutions into existing electrical infrastructure. The role also includes preparing reports, contributing to project proposals, and maintaining alignment with UniPower’s quality, safety, and reliability standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong knowledge of the solar industry, including solar power and solar systems. Candidates should possess skills in PV design and solar system configuration. Candidates should possess skills in electrical design and power system fundamentals. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Ability to interpret technical drawings, single-line diagrams, and electrical schematics. Familiarity with industry standards, local regulations, and safety practices for solar and electrical installations. Proficiency with engineering and design software (e.g., PV design tools, AutoCAD or similar). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities, with attention to detail. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate on-site with cross-functional teams. Willingness to work on-site in Qesm 2nd 6 October and conduct field visits as required.
